name: Lincoln Memorial University
academic_ranking: Private university in Harrogate, TN, chartered 1897 as a memorial to Abraham Lincoln. Accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools (SACS). ~6,081 total students (Fall 2023), of which ~1,668 undergraduates. 1,000-acre main campus bordering Cumberland Gap National Historical Park. Home to notable graduate/professional colleges (DeBusk College of Osteopathic Medicine, Gillespie College of Veterinary Medicine, Duncan School of Law).
financial_aid: LMU Federal School Code 003502. Financial aid contact: finaid@LMUnet.edu / 423.869.6336. Scholarship application due Jan 31; FAFSA-based aid available; TSAA (Tennessee) FAFSA deadline April 1. As an NCAA D2 program, softball can offer athletic scholarships in addition to academic and need-based aid. Exact tuition figure not verified from a public source at time of research.
facilities_notes: Railsplitters softball competes at the on-campus softball facility on LMU's 1,000-acre Harrogate campus. Specific facility name/details not confirmed on public softball program pages at time of research.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the South Atlantic Conference (SAC). Part of the LMU Railsplitters athletics department.
notes: Coaching staff and roster confirmed live from https://www.lmurailsplitters.com/sports/softball on 2026-07 (2026 season). Softball coaches page listed only two staff members (head coach and one assistant); no volunteer/graduate assistants, recruiting coordinators, or directors of operations were listed. Team social handle is @LMU_Softball. Tuition figure could not be verified from a public primary source and is left null rather than estimated.
